retail.title: Retail Solutions
intro: We have been partners with EduSoft System Solutions for many years and because of their satisfactory work we haven't even thought about any other software. Good thing is that it is not the same as it was in the start, as our business grew, the features in the software also grow which makes the work much easier for us.

If I were to describe the importance of EduSoft, I would say that it has a humongous effect on Ahsan Medicine Co. is today. All the satisfied clients who visit and re visit us due to our fast service, the software from EduSoft Solutions plays a big role behind that. Well Done!
A very fine software. All our records are now organized and the fast billing has ease the over crowded burden on us. We are very happy with the software and its services.
